title: Hokkaido Voted Most Attractive Prefecture for 18th Time
paragraphs: What makes a place attractive? It could be beautiful scenery, interesting cities or maybe famous buildings.
Japan's Hokkaido has all of these things. And it has been named the country's most attractive prefecture for the 18th year in a row.

This comes from a yearly survey by the Brand Research Institute in Tokyo. Almost 32,000 people took part in the survey, which looked at all 47 prefectures in Japan. People were asked how attractive they found each prefecture, giving each one a score from one to five.
Hokkaido came first, and Kyoto and Okinawa came second and third. The same three prefectures have held the top three places for seven years in a row.
Found far in Japan's north, many people visit Hokkaido for skiing in the winter. And in February, the Sapporo Snow Festival fills the city with big snow and ice sculptures.

In the warmer months, visitors to Hokkaido can enjoy the colorful flower fields of Furano, or go hiking at Daisetsuzan National Park, the largest national park in Japan. The prefecture is also famous for its seafood, milk and cheese, which are sold all over the country.
Second-place Kyoto is loved for its history and its many temples. And third-place Okinawa is famous for its beaches and warm weather.
At the other end of the list, Saga came last, just below Ibaraki, Gunma and Saitama.
But after 18 years at the top, Hokkaido is still Japan's number one!
